crossRefs.note: “If a man entices a virgin who isn’t pledged to be married, and lies with her, he shall surely pay a dowry for her to…
If her father utterly refuses to give her to him, he shall pay money according to the dowry of virgins.

translations.web: If a man finds a lady who is a virgin, who is not pledged to be married, grabs her and lies with her, and they are found,
translations.bsb: If a man encounters a virgin who is not pledged in marriage, and he seizes her and lies with her, and they are discovered,
translations.kjv: If a man find a damsel that is a virgin, which is not betrothed, and lay hold on her, and lie with her, and they be found;
translations.asv: If a man find a damsel that is a virgin, that is not betrothed, and lay hold on her, and lie with her, and they be found;
